clips.title: The story
paras: At Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace, Thyn'tel Bladeweaver searches for the vanished Priestess Velinde Starsong. She sends trusted Alliance adventurers after clues to Velinde's whereabouts and the mystery of the Scythe of Elune.

On the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus, Thyn'tel Bladeweaver keeps watch as a night elf sentinel. Priestess Velinde Starsong vanished without a word, and Thyn'tel refuses to let her trail go cold. Believing grave forces may be involved, she sends trusted adventurers to search Velinde's belongings and learn where her journey led.
